templates.description: Epidemiological transmission pass-through linking effective reproduction rate to clinical case incidence and hospital admissions.
When ICU bed occupancy breaches safe staffing limits, triage delays elevate case fatality across severe acute conditions.
Population vaccination coverage and prior-infection immunity reduce susceptible host density and blunt secondary attack rates.
Seasonal warming and standing floodwater expand vector habitat suitability and lengthen vector-borne outbreak seasons.
